name: Paradox: The Novel
source:
Paradox: the Novel is a visual novel story, set in a strange dimension that is controlled by the forces yet unknown.

The world of Eternia was once a peaceful place, until a deception from an unknown source made young prince Henry of Landark start a war to avenge his father. This war was supposed to end after the final battle between Henry and the ruler of Noviest, lady Ayina. It never did, as an Evil Spirit had locked the heroes inside of a chaotic dimension called Paradox.

It has changed their nature, but indeed, the spirit of a devoted warrior can never be broken!

Join the path of nameless soul, left with no memories of its past, who explores the new world, where heroes of the past were bound to live for centuries.

[From [url=https://yuqio.itch.io/paradox-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Paradox: The Novel》是一部視覺小說，故事發生在一個奇異的維度，掌控它的力量至今無人知曉。

埃特尼亞曾是個和平的世界，直到有人暗中設局，誘使蘭達克的年輕王子亨利為父報仇，發動戰爭。這場戰爭本該在亨利與諾維斯特的統治者艾伊娜女士決戰後結束，卻始終未能落幕：一個惡靈把英雄們鎖進了名為「悖論」的混亂維度。

這改變了他們的本性，但忠於信念的戰士，其精神確實永遠不會屈服！

跟隨一個無名靈魂的腳步，探索這個新世界。它對自己的過去毫無記憶，而昔日的英雄們已被迫在這裡生活了好幾個世紀。

［摘自[url=https://yuqio.itch.io/paradox-novel]itch.io[/url]］
